@@U03479@@
Greater, ever greater, looming nearer, the goddess’s encircling throne approaches! Appalling, monstrous to behold! Its flames grow dark, they're turning red! Gigantic round, come no closer! You will destroy us all, land, sea, and man! It’s true, then, what they say! Thessalian witches once with wicked magic chanted you down from your monthly round and wrested from you the utmost in destruction! Ah! Darkness now shrouds the luminous shield that all at once explodes in flames, showering sparks in every direction! What a clattering! What a hissing! The heavens thunder and hurricanes blow! Goddess, humbly at the foot of your throne I cast myself! Forgive! It was I who called it down!

@@U03480@@
(He throws himself prostrate to the ground.)

@@U03482@@
The things this man hears and sees! I can’t be sure exactly what happened to us, but I certainly didn’t go through what he’s been through. At least we'll agree these are very odd times. And yet, there’s Luna rocking away up there just as she’s always done.

@@U03484@@

translation:
@@U03479@@
更大，越来越大，越来越近，环绕着女神的宝座逼近了！令人毛骨悚然，令人目瞪口呆！它的火焰变暗，变成红色！巨大的圆球，不要靠近！你将毁灭我们所有人，陆地、海洋和人类！那么，他们说的是真的！色萨利女巫曾经用邪恶的魔法将你从每月的回合中驱逐出去，并从你手中夺走了最大的毁灭！啊!黑暗笼罩了发光护盾，护盾立刻爆炸成火焰，火花四溅！多么哗啦啦！多么嘶嘶啊！苍天雷霆，飓风袭来！女神啊，我卑微地拜在您的宝座下！原谅！是我叫下来的！

@@U03480@@
（他倒在地上。）

@@U03482@@
这个人所听到和看到的事情！我不能确定我们到底发生了什么，但我肯定没有经历过他所经历的事情。至少我们会同意现在是非常奇怪的时期。然而，卢娜却像往常一样在上面摇摆。

@@U03484@@
